In September 2026, from Moday 13th to Wednesday 16th, Schloss Dagstuhl will host the seminar **“Frontiers of Technology-Assisted Review Systems”**, bringing together researchers and practitioners working on Technology-Assisted Review (TAR) across different application domains and research communities.

The seminar aims to foster discussion around the current state and future directions of TAR, including high-recall information retrieval, machine learning, eDiscovery, systematic reviews, and related evidence-discovery workflows.

I am very happy to have helped make this event happen together with my co-organizers **Evangelos Kanoulas, Udo Kruschwitz, and Jeremy Pickens**, and particularly pleased that we were able to bring together so many colleagues and friends who have contributed to shaping this research area over the years.
